title: Road Vehicle Signs
hook: A road rule only belongs to road traffic.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D road-vehicle storybook, toy-like vehicles, safe roads, clean silhouettes; visual identity: Road Vehicle Signs

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child testing whether road rules apply
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: vehicle fact plus explicit mode when premise could mislead
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Road Vehicle Signs into a road-sign lesson with explicit non-road comparison cards: Jet, Plane, Narrowboat, Yacht, Zeppelin are not road vehicles; signs, lanes and work zones apply only where the mode fits.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child places road machines on sign-controlled streets while pulling air/water vehicles to a separate map.
